title: Every allow list that names the merge tool's flags agrees with the code's flag constant
why: Item 458 a adds three batch flags to the merge tool's allow rule in settings.json. merge/cloud_allow.json has no "Merge Tool Read Checks" entry, and its tests pin exactly 3 rules. hooks/guard_stream.py CHECK_FLAGS also lists read-check flags. Neither was checked against the new flags. Rule building-allow-list-is-the-constant says an allow list points at the constant the code emits.
note: Coordinator (13:23 CST Nov 9), from #2378's 458 a builder. Not a hold. Related: step batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce (the 458 a edit).
